Swedish

Etymology

From Old Swedish smār, from Old Norse smár, from Proto-Germanic *smēhaz.

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /smoː/
  • Audio (Gotland):(file)
  • Rhymes: -oː

Adjective

små

  1. plural of liten
    de små männen
    the small men
    tre små grisar
    three small pigs
    smågnagare
    small rodents

Usage notes

  • Originally an independent adjective meaning "small", små is now exclusively used in the absolute plural (though see smått).
  • The comparative and superlative smärre and smärst derive from this base form, although they are now considered dated.

Derived terms

  • småbarn
  • småkaka
  • Småland
  • småningom
  • småvilt

Related terms

  • smått

References

  • “små”, in Svenska Akademiens ordböcker [Dictionaries of the Swedish Academy] (in Swedish)
  • små in Elof Hellquist, Svensk etymologisk ordbok (1st ed., 1922)
